frozen_rule.formation: r_s(t)=close_s(t)/close_s(t-12 bars)-1; leader=first argmax and laggard=first argmin in frozen six-symbol order
frozen_rule.entry_predicate: spread>=0.03 AND same leader/laggard as previous bar AND current spread<previous spread
frozen_rule.pair: long original laggard 0.5 + short original leader 0.5; gross weights sum to 1
frozen_rule.signal_anchor: Freeze original leader, laggard, signal_spread6h and pair segment IDs at signal
frozen_rule.child_exit: From held bar 4, original leader return over its current trailing 12 bars minus original laggard return >= frozen signal spread
frozen_rule.exit_precedence_bar8: Native exit_update overwrites TIME_8BAR with THESIS_REEXPAND_FAIL_BAR4 when both predicates hold
frozen_rule.entry_time: At native signal bar close/availability, intent targets the next chronological common 30m open; no future open is a feature
frozen_rule.exit_time: Closed-bar decision; exit_next_open request only. No same-close fill.
frozen_rule.occupancy: One pair globally per native identity; no replacement signal on same close used for native exit; real reservations additionally checked outside native grammar

dependency_closure.legacy_regime_role: Stored diagnostics/train-hold split only; not an entry/exit filter in the frozen MR replay

input_availability.frame_universe: All six symbols, each unique; no dynamic universe or silently dropped missing leg
input_availability.bar_integrity: UTC 30m open grid, close=open+1800000, finite positive OHLC and valid OHLC geometry; ordered unique timestamps and preserved segments
input_availability.contiguity: At least 21 consecutive complete common bars after a segment reset; no row compression across missing six-symbol timestamps
input_availability.signal_inputs: Current 6h return needs 13 close observations; prior-bar return and same-extremes/contraction comparison needs 14. Native 20-index warmup is preserved.
input_availability.exit_inputs: Fixed original pair only; each needs 13 complete contiguous closes ending at current bar and one segment; current closes and history must be available at decision
input_availability.decision_ts: max(current close time, all six current available times, prior native decision time); preserve actual received/usable evidence
input_availability.reference_clock: Input as_of/reference wall clock must bound observed availability; preserved monotonic samples may not reverse. No future or unfinished bars admitted.
input_availability.observed_source: Use existing observed source receipts/cursors and actual constituent availability. Historical BAR_CLOSE_MODEL is not actual observed delivery.
input_availability.provenance_limit: Hash validation binds caller-supplied bytes and lineage claims; it does not independently certify exchange origin or historical completeness.
input_availability.late_entry: Native model-next-open already passed when actual decision/availability exceeds signal close: preserve observation with state HOLD and reason LATE_MODEL_ENTRY_NO_RETROACTIVE_FILL; do not fabricate that open or silently delay to another open.
input_availability.late_exit_or_gap: No missing pair price, guessed synchronized fill or gap compression. Preserve unresolved/occupied status; a new execution-clock policy requires owner authority.
input_availability.volume: Native MR is price-only. Unknown volume units remain UNKNOWN and are not transformed into a volume/OFI gate.
input_availability.cost: Positive finite costs_bps for all six are caller-bound reference round-trip scenarios, not externally verified fee/funding facts. Unknown cost is not zero. Weighted pair 2x=2*1x cost only; no profit calculation or geometry change. Actual fee/funding source/time authority remains unverified by this adapter.
input_availability.occupancy: External occupied/reserved symbols and reservation ID prevent parallel products from implicitly reusing funds; adapter cannot release unresolved positions or alter owner ledger.

adapter_interface.clock_proof: Existing scalp7.actual_source_clock_barrier.v3 full schema/samples; validated by pinned _usable only, never generated or rewritten by this adapter
adapter_interface.no_reservation: PENDING_EXTERNAL_CAPITAL_RESERVATION even if free; no reservation mutation or capital allocation
adapter_interface.position_validation: Re-admit the complete original snapshot through prepare_signals; require exact native signal and original reservation, compare unchanged history overlap, and reject any earlier native exit trigger or unresolved lifecycle source. entry_reference_ts_ms is a model reference, not a claimed fill.
adapter_interface.dedup: Reuse existing canonical opportunity key and supplied seen_opportunity_keys; no producer registration or state writing
